This issue may no longer be valid in `v4.7-dev3`.  (I haven't tested in any other versions.)

Additionally, FYI: there is a link to this issue from the Godot docs: https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/engine_details/development/compiling/compiling_for_ios.html#compiling
Build was fixed by https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/102179 (by disabling broken Metal and Vulkan renderers when building for simulator).
